instruction: Open PyCharm from the Applications menu, create a new Pure Python project named "pycharm_task_proj" in the default location, add a file "main.py" with code that writes "pycharm_success" to "run_marker.txt" in the project root, then run the script once.

verification.condition: Check if the file ~/PycharmProjects/pycharm_task_proj/run_marker.txt exists and its exact content is "pycharm_success".
verification.expected_result: File run_marker.txt is created at the specified path with exactly the text "pycharm_success".
